overview: The Liu Song was the first of the Southern Dynasties, ruling from Jiankang. Despite political instability, this period saw significant cultural and intellectual achievements in the south.

items.text: Zu Chongzhi proposes the Daming calendar, the first in China to allow for the precession of the equinoxes.
Zu Chongzhi (429 to 500) bounds pi between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927, a precision not bettered anywhere for about nine centuries.
The poet Xie Lingyun (385 to 433) develops landscape poetry as a major genre.
Southern culture developed distinctive characteristics that influenced later periods.

fall.text: The last Liu Song emperor was deposed by Xiao Daocheng, who founded the Southern Qi dynasty.

sources.title: The Cambridge History of China, volume 2: The Six Dynasties, 220 to 589 (2019)
